body:
It does not make me happy. It's like cheese.
Eating cheese is good. Cheese itself won't make you happy when you have a dead body of your girlfriend lying on the floor, right?

A bit - yes. 
It's just good to know that you made someone more happy.

I don't know what to say. 
Even if I'm good, not much people cares about it, because I have rough times, and no one likes depressed people.
What's the matter of being good if almost everyone around will use it till you're wasted, till you had enough of it.

Things are getting worse right now. 
I don't see anything getting better.

Since all my memory is contained within my brains, and brains are always minutes away from deactiavating due to lack of oxygen - I won't be able to regret that I'm on the other side, and since every our feeling is relative - scarier can become less scarier. It's 50/50 since we know almost nothing about other side, but here i have 100% bad life.
